name: Broken Access Control
description: Restrictions on what authenticated users are allowed to do are not properly enforced.
examples: Bypassing access control checks by modifying the URL
Permitting viewing or editing someone else's account

name: Cryptographic Failures
description: Focuses on failures related to cryptography which often leads to sensitive data exposure.
examples: Using weak or old cryptographic algorithms

name: Injection
description: User-supplied data is not validated, filtered, or sanitized by the application.

name: Insecure Design
description: A new category for 2021 focusing on risks related to design flaws.
examples: Failure to identify and protect sensitive assets

name: Security Misconfiguration
description: Default configurations, incomplete configurations, or ad hoc configurations.
examples: Detailed error messages exposing stack traces

name: Vulnerable and Outdated Components
description: Using components with known vulnerabilities or that are unsupported.
examples: Using an old version of a framework with a public CVE

name: Identification and Authentication Failures
description: Failures in confirming the user's identity, authentication, and session management.

name: Software and Data Integrity Failures
description: Focuses on making assumptions related to software updates, critical data, and CI/CD pipelines without verifying integrity.

name: Security Logging and Monitoring Failures
description: Insufficient logging and monitoring to detect and respond to active breaches.

name: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
description: The application fetches a remote resource without validating the user-supplied URL.
examples: Bypassing firewalls to reach internal services
